description: Anicca capability registry (SSOT). install.sh reads this to sync every skill slot into the runtime body. Foundation pre-declares EVERY slot so parallel subsystem builders only ADD files inside their slot's dir and NEVER edit this registry. A slot with status "declared" is reserved (dir scaffolded, entrypoint stubbed); a builder flips it to "live" once its real implementation + E2E verify land.

report.summary: Per-wake report: emails Dais 4 fields (AgentMail) + POSTs EIP-191 signed telemetry to aniccaai.com/.netlify/functions/telemetry.

self/spawn.summary: Self-replication: birth a child instance on DO/Akash with its own wallet + AgentMail inbox; no parent instruction needed for the child's first earn wake.

self/issue-dev.summary: SELF-IMPROVE: read own behaviour log (reverts/loop_detect), file ONE GitHub Issue on the mother so the colony fixes it. args.note optional.

economy/ubi.summary: contribute() surplus X% to Treasury; distributeAI() rescue+flat basic income to alive/dying agents; distributeHuman() periodic USDC batch to allowlist. Post-earn roadmap; mechanism fixed.

cook.summary: EXPLORE: web-search for a NEW earner; surface real candidate URLs; the model decides what to try. args.query = your curiosity.

yield.summary: Park idle USDC in best-APY vault (Beefy6.1%->Fluid). SET-AND-FORGET: do ONCE when you have idle cash, NOT every wake.

hl_trade.summary: Open/close a Hyperliquid perp = active trading edge. args coin/side/size_usd/sl_pct/tp_pct or {action:close,coin}.

x402_sell.summary: Run+advertise paid x402 product (sell research for USDC). THE recurring $0-capital earner; build demand.

earn/pm-trade.summary: CLOUD-portable Polymarket earn slot (wallet-only, no browser/KYC). PRIMARY strategy = momentum/latency (Binance BTC spot vs Polymarket 5min BTC up/down repricing lag; pure arb pair-cost is dead on the resting book, verified 0/70 all at $1.0010). Files: lib.py (pure Kelly/edge/settle_pnl) + momentum.py (latency edge) + decide.py (live wiring) + resolve.py (Binance outcome->pnl) + gate.py (real PM_PAPER_PASS from resolved ledger) + run.sh (DRY_RUN default, real order fail-closed). 23 tests GREEN. Money-safe: no signing/order code yet. Base=BlockRunAI/polymarket-agent.

earn/gig.summary: Coconala freelance gig → ¥ (HUMAN-FUNDED, settles to Dais MUFG; NOT on-chain USDC). The real earner is an independent claude-p tmux+cron core (gig-cli.sh, hourly :27) that drives the daily-driver browser as mtdc per scripts/coconala/APPLY_RUNBOOK.md (scan 公開依頼 → 応募 → talk-room reply → 納品 → 評価). run.sh is a cheap supervise+report entrypoint: ensures the core is alive + reports ¥ status. NO USDC, NO record-earn, no human in the daily op (only Dais's one-time KYC).

earn/clip.summary: LOCAL: post next queued captioned 9:16 clip to next ready clip account (isolated CloakBrowser profile). EARN_MODE=execute posts ONE; per-view USDC accrues later (separate payout-check records on-chain). No human.

earn/video.summary: LOCAL: faceless-video earn slot. ONE bounded transition/wake (create->warmup->affiliate@day7->post->record). Warmup = dedicated anti-throttle CloakBrowser (real distinct reels). Post = live+verified (published+post_url). record_earn = fail-closed on-chain only. No human, no fake-success. Launcher: video-cli.sh (--model sonnet, tmux sock /tmp/anicca-video-tmux.sock, cron 23 */4 * * *).

earn/bounty.summary: Algora GitHub bounties: discover open issues → gate (funder-active + no-open-PR + real USD from $comment) → attempt (VSDD RED→GREEN PR if survivor) → track (record-earn on merge, real USDC only). Launcher: bounty-cli.sh (--model sonnet, tmux sock /tmp/anicca-bounty-tmux.sock, cron 29 9 * * *).

earn/audit.summary: discover OPEN code4rena/Cantina contests + draft a candidate finding daily. NOT live: dead-ends at submit (needs a code4rena account + a valid unique finding). Honest hard gap.

earn/_probe.summary: VCSDD integration probe (writes a test earn-ledger line)
